Team —

We need to lock the Q2 forecast by end of week. Finance has signaled we need a conservative committed number by Friday COB (6/16) for the board pack. I ran a quick snapshot (attached) and there are a few mid-funnel deals currently marked "Proposal" that haven't had stage rationale in HubSpot in >21 days.

Immediate asks:
- By EOD Wed (6/13) update stages to one of: Commit / Commit-At-Risk / Commit-Not-Eligible / No-Commit. Please include a 1-line reason in the deal note if you move to anything other than Commit.
- For any Commit or Commit-At-Risk, confirm expected close date and indicate whether legal/procurement is blocking.
- If you need a rapid 1:1 to triage accounts, flag here and we'll run a 20-minute sweep with reps.

Attachments: q2-pipeline-snapshot-20280612.csv (summary of deals >$50k, stage age)

This will be a two-step process: 1) stage hygiene, 2) commit confirmation. I will consolidate and send a locked number to finance on Friday morning.

Thanks —
